question: Otto is able to listen to the voices of animals, but aside from the ground dragon that was pulling his dragon carriage, are there any other animals that he’s good friends with?
answer: Likely, in waterways near roads that he uses frequently, there’s a long-lived turtle or that sort of familiar face.  But, upon being seen by other people when conversing with the turtle, they probably had a parting along the lines of “You’re a human, Otto.  Don’t worry about us.  It’s time to go.”  “Turtle-san…. Turtle-sa~n!”.
